items.source: Return the delimiter from the last invocation of match(DataBuffer).
items.translation: 返回上次调用match(DataBuffer)的分隔符。

items.source: Contract to find delimiter(s) against one or more data buffers that can be passed one at a time to the match(DataBuffer) method.
items.translation: 用于查找一个或多个数据缓冲区中分隔符的合约，这些缓冲区可以逐个传递给match(DataBuffer)方法。

items.source: Find the first matching delimiter and return the index of the last byte of the delimiter, or -1 if not found.
items.translation: 找到第一个匹配的分隔符并返回该分隔符最后一个字节的索引，如果未找到则返回 `-1`。

items.source: Reset the state of this matcher.
